name: NYC x DSSG
heroSubtitle: From tech unemployment to career-ready work.
heroDescription: Entry-level tech job postings in New York City have fallen 49% since 2022 — the steepest drop of any field. The Data Diplomats Training Program matches job-seeking technologists with qualified nonprofits and NGOs that are federally funded yet funding-scarce, so candidates gain career-ready experience solving real data and IT problems through human-centered AI.
